scenario.title: 討論環保、永續和企業責任
scenario.context: 談環保常會回顧過去：「如果我們二十年前就開始減碳，現在就不會這麼糟」。這種「過去沒發生的假設」是第三類條件句：If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.，是英文條件句裡最難、也最能表達遺憾的一種。

lines.speaker: Client
lines.en: We want our new packaging to look eco-friendly.
lines.zh: 我們希望新包裝看起來很環保。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Great. Are you planning to change the materials too, or just the look?
lines.zh: 很好。你們打算連材質一起換，還是只換外觀？

lines.speaker: Client
lines.en: Just the look for now. Materials are expensive.
lines.zh: 目前只換外觀，材料很貴。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'd be careful. Customers are pretty good at spotting greenwashing these days.
lines.zh: 我會建議小心點。現在消費者很會看出漂綠。

lines.speaker: Client
lines.en: Hmm. A competitor got a lot of criticism for that last year.
lines.zh: 嗯，去年有個競爭對手就因為這樣被罵很慘。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Exactly. If they had changed their materials, they wouldn't have gotten so much backlash.
lines.zh: 就是。如果他們當初換了材質，就不會被那麼多人反彈。

lines.speaker: Client
lines.en: Good point. Let me talk to our supplier about recycled paper.
lines.zh: 說得好。我去跟供應商談談再生紙。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I'm trying to go green. I stopped using plastic straws.
lines.zh: 我在努力過環保生活，不用塑膠吸管了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: That's nice, but isn't it just a drop in the bucket?
lines.zh: 很好，但那不是杯水車薪嗎？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Maybe. But if everyone had done it ten years ago, we would have saved billions of straws.
lines.zh: 也許吧。但如果十年前大家都這樣做，我們早就省下幾十億根吸管了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: True. My mom calls me a tree hugger because I bike to work.
lines.zh: 也對。我媽因為我騎腳踏車上班，叫我環保狂熱份子。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Ha! If I had known how much I'd save on gas, I would have started biking years ago.
lines.zh: 哈！如果我早知道能省多少油錢，幾年前就開始騎了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Good for the planet and your wallet.

patterns.en: What's your company doing about sustainability?
patterns.zh: 你們公司在永續方面做了什麼？

patterns.en: It's a step in the right direction.
patterns.zh: 這是往正確方向的一步。

patterns.en: I try to reduce my plastic use.
Climate change affects all of us.
patterns.zh: 氣候變遷影響我們每個人。

patterns.en: It's not just about individuals. Companies need to change too.
patterns.zh: 這不只是個人的事，企業也要改變。

patterns.en: I'd rather pay more for something sustainable.
patterns.zh: 我寧願為永續的東西多付一點錢。

chinglish.wrong: If I knew earlier, I would bike to work.
chinglish.right: If I had known earlier, I would have biked to work.
chinglish.why: 「早知道就…」是對過去的假設，要用第三類條件句。中文的「如果」不分過去現在。

chinglish.wrong: If they changed the material, they won't be criticized.
chinglish.right: If they had changed the material, they wouldn't have been criticized.
chinglish.why: 講過去沒發生的事，兩邊都要往前推：had + p.p. / would have + p.p.。

chinglish.right: I try to be eco-friendly. / I care about the environment.
chinglish.why: environment 前要加 the；而且「我保護環境」直翻太大，說具體行動更自然。
environmental 是「環境的」，不是「環保的」。

grammar.title: 條件句 type 3
grammar.oneLiner: If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.：假設過去發生了不同的事，結果會怎樣（但都已經不可能了）。
whenToUse: 過去沒發生的假設：If I had known, I would have told you.（但我不知道，所以沒說）
表達遺憾：If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
主要子句可以用 could have / might have：We could have saved money.
口語縮寫：If I'd known, I'd have… / I would've…
倒裝（正式）：Had I known, I would have told you.
比較：type 1（真的可能）、type 2（現在不太可能）、type 3（過去已經不可能）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「早知道就…」「要是當初…」講的明明是過去，但動詞不變。英文的條件句用「往後退一格」表達假設程度：type 2 退到過去式，type 3 再退到過去完成式。台灣人常用 type 2 來講過去（If I knew, I would…），聽起來像在講現在。

examples.correct: If I had known about the sale, I would have bought two.
examples.incorrect: If I knew about the sale, I would buy two.

examples.correct: We wouldn't have been late if the bus had come on time.
If she had asked me, I could have helped.
If I'd studied harder, I might have passed.
examples.note: 口語縮寫 I'd = I had。

examples.correct: Had we acted sooner, we would have saved more forests.

quiz.question: If I ___ about the meeting, I would have come.
If we had left earlier, we ___ the train.
If you had asked, I ___ have helped you.
Which one talks about the PAST?
options: If I had time, I'd help.
If I had had time, I'd have helped.
If I have time, I'll help.
quiz.explanation: had had + would have = type 3，講過去。

quiz.question: If they ___ (use) recycled paper, they wouldn't have been criticized.

slang.meaning: 走環保路線、過環保生活
slang.usage: 個人或企業開始注重環保。

examples.en: Our office is going green. No more paper cups.
examples.zh: 我們辦公室要走環保路線，不再用紙杯了。

examples.en: Going green doesn't have to be expensive.
examples.zh: 過環保生活不一定很花錢。

slang.usage: 企業誇大或捏造環保形象。動詞 greenwash。

risk.note: 是很重的批評，對客戶說他們在 greenwashing 要委婉。

examples.en: Putting a leaf on the logo without changing anything is just greenwashing.
examples.zh: 什麼都沒改，只在 logo 加片葉子，那就是漂綠。

examples.en: Consumers are getting better at spotting greenwashing.
examples.zh: 消費者越來越會識破漂綠了。

slang.usage: 相對於整體問題，貢獻太小。英式也說 a drop in the ocean。

risk.note: 中性用語，但說別人的努力是 a drop in the bucket 可能讓人洩氣。

examples.en: Our donation was just a drop in the bucket.
examples.zh: 我們的捐款只是杯水車薪。

examples.en: Every drop in the bucket adds up eventually.
examples.zh: 每一滴水最終都會積少成多。

slang.meaning: 環保狂熱份子（常帶揶揄）
slang.usage: 形容非常熱衷環保的人，常帶輕微嘲諷。

risk.note: 可能被當成貶低環保人士。自嘲可以，說別人時要看交情。

examples.en: Call me a tree hugger, but I think we should ban plastic bags.
examples.zh: 你可以說我是環保狂，但我覺得應該禁用塑膠袋。

examples.en: He's a bit of a tree hugger, but he means well.
examples.zh: 他有點環保狂熱，但他是好意。

review.question: ___ the high cost, they switched to recycled materials.
review.explanation: 複習第 63 單元：despite + 名詞。

review.question: They launched a ___-year plan to cut emissions. (十年)
review.explanation: 複習第 62 單元：a ten-year plan。

review.question: I ___ use plastic bags, but now I bring my own.
review.explanation: 複習第 60 單元：used to + 原形。

review.question: By 2030, the city ___ all its buses to electric.
review.explanation: 複習第 56 單元：未來完成式。

review.question: Recycled paper costs ___ regular paper.
review.explanation: 複習第 48 單元：倍數比較。

review.question: By the time scientists warned us, the damage ___ already begun.
review.explanation: 複習第 32 單元：過去完成式。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: If I knew, I would have told you.
If I had known, I would have told you.
If I have known, I would tell you.
